Grade: PP1
Subject: LANGUAGE ACTIVITIES
Strand: WRITING
Topic 4.2: Writing readiness skills.

This lesson covers Writing readiness skills., part of WRITING in PP1 LANGUAGE ACTIVITIES.

Key inquiry question: How do we hold a readiness learners should be able to: turn pages and practise turning pages from right to writing tool?
